topic: How does the dual-mode operation of the CTS antenna impact frequency reuse and coverage patterns in Ka-band satellite architectures?
consensus_response: Dual-mode CTS antennas enhance frequency reuse via polarization diversity, reducing co-channel interference. However, rain attenuation disproportionately affects polarizations, disrupting balance. Phased array technologies and adaptive modulation techniques mitigate these effects, optimizing link resilience and spectral efficiency under adverse weather conditions.
reference_context: Ka-band satellite systems face challenges from rain attenuation and spectrum scarcity, prompting moves to higher frequencies and smaller antenna sizes.
